objective: Turn the desk from a scanner into a realized-execution trading system over multiple runs without destabilizing the fast path.

phases.rollout_rule: Optimal prices are advisory for unproven spreads and receive allocation authority only after Phase-1 persistence validation clears. GP-per-slot-hour uses probability-weighted realized-cycle economics rather than raw spread.

phases.entry_condition: Evaluate after Phase 2 has accumulated multiple relay cycles and the persistence engine has promoted enough markets to generate meaningful active-slot observations.

migration_rule: Later phases consume Phase-1 execution/persistence and Phase-2 price/slot outputs instead of creating parallel scoring systems. New features are introduced behind configuration, observed over multiple relay cycles, and only then receive allocation authority.
